claims.claim: A business jet crashed in a Florida neighborhood on Sunday, exploded, and killed all nine people aboard.

claims.claim: Photos and video showed the jet diving nose first and exploding, and a pilot said it was descending at 20,000 feet per minute.

claims.supporting_quote: Photos and video posted online showed the business jet diving nose first to the ground and exploding. In a radio call, a pilot said the plane was descending at 20,000 feet per minute.
